_comment: Layout of the Forever XP Discord server. tools/discord_bot.py setup applies it (adds and updates; the only deletes are roles listed in retired_roles). Channel types: text, voice, announcement, forum. readonly = members can read but not post (the bot and moderators still can). aliases = old names, so a renamed channel is renamed rather than duplicated. feed = the channel that gets Blizzard's new changes and news. message = a file in discord/messages that the bot posts in that read-only channel and edits when the file changes ({#channel-name} becomes a channel link).
_private_channels: Staff-only channels. The bot creates one if it's missing (hidden from @everyone); an existing one is only checked, never changed.

channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: Start here: what Forever XP is and where the tools are. Accept the rules to start posting.

channels.name: rules
channels.topic: Server rules. Be decent, no spam, no cheating or account selling.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Forever XP news: new tools, guides and data updates from forever-xp.com. Follow this channel to get them in your own server.

channels.name: forever-announcements
channels.topic: WoW Forever updates as Blizzard posts them: class and racial changes, development notes and news. Posted automatically. Search every change at https://forever-xp.com/changes/

channels.name: bis-and-gearing
channels.topic: One thread per question. Share your BIS plan link from https://forever-xp.com/bis/

channels.name: leveling-routes
channels.topic: Route feedback, faster paths and quests worth skipping. Routes: https://forever-xp.com/guides/

channels.name: class-talk
channels.topic: Builds, talents and tips by class. Talent calculator: https://forever-xp.com/talents/

channels.name: pvp
channels.topic: Battlegrounds, world PvP and PvP gear.

channels.name: lfg
channels.topic: Looking for group: say your level, role, faction and what you're running.

channels.name: clips-and-highlights
channels.topic: Your best moments in WoW Forever.

channels.name: quest-data
channels.topic: Wrong coordinates, missing quests, new Forever quests. Confirmed fixes go to Questie.

channels.name: site-feedback
channels.topic: Bugs and ideas for forever-xp.com. Security problems: report privately on GitHub, not here.

channels.name: foreverscout-help
channels.topic: Help with the ForeverScout addon and uploader: https://forever-xp.com/scout/

_roles: Listed top to bottom in display order: a member's name takes the color of their highest colored role. hoist = shown in its own group in the member list. color is optional (no color). The bot creates roles with no permissions and never changes permissions on existing roles.
_retired_roles: Roles the bot removes from the server if they exist. Only names listed here are ever deleted.
